reviewCharts.warning: Arizona review rows are county-level President-versus-U.S. Senate comparisons from signed canvass county totals. They are useful for statewide county review, but they are not precinct-level vote-share scatter plots.

turnout.notes: Arizona turnout rows use the official signed statewide canvass Total Eligible Registration and Total Ballots Cast rows.

historicalBaselines.warning: Arizona historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Wikipedia county tables with state-source footnotes. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.

historicalReview.warning: Arizona historical advisory rows compare official county presidential and U.S. Senate totals for 2016 and 2020. They are county-level screening context, not precinct scatter-plot evidence. Candidate and contest differences, split-ticket voting, and participation differences can explain observed patterns; advisory indicators are not findings of fraud or misconduct.

caveats: The signed Arizona canvass package supports county certified results, county President-versus-U.S. Senate advisory review, and county turnout denominators only.
